title: A WRITTEN-OFF loan credits LOSSES_WRITTEN_OFF and debits DEFERRED_INCOME_LIABILITY for a buy-down fee amortization (loan 15 L521: CREDIT account 15 100.00, DEBIT account 22 100.00)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the TWO-LEG journal entry a BUY_DOWN_FEE_AMORTIZATION transaction posts on a loan that is WRITTEN OFF (not charged off), on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_PROGRESSIVE_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_BUYDOWN_FEES) at the amortization transaction L521. request.buy_down_fee_amortization_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's amortization transaction id 521 (type loanTransactionType.buyDownFeeAmortization): interestPortion 100.0 -> "10000" and feeChargesPortion 0 -> "0" minor units. The loan read-back carries a NON-REVERSED writeOff transaction id 520 dated 2024-01-02 and with a LOWER id than the amortization, so request.buy_down_fee_amortization_journal.written_off is true; the loan is NOT charged off and its fraud flag is false. request.buy_down_fee_amortization_journal.accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping read back from the accepted create request create-request-LP2_PROGRESSIVE_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_BUYDOWN_FEES.json: incomeFromBuyDownAccountId 24, deferredIncomeLiabilityAccountId 22, writeOffAccountId 15, chargeOffExpenseAccountId 18, chargeOffFraudExpenseAccountId 16. expect.buy_down_fee_amortization_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the two L521 legs in id order from the journal-entries sweep: id 1097 entryType CREDIT glAccountId 15 amount 100.0 and id 1098 DEBIT glAccountId 22 amount 100.0. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a written-off loan's amortization credits LOSSES_WRITTEN_OFF (15), not income from buy down (24), and debits the same total to deferred income liability. It is the account cell that discriminates the ignore-loan-state drive. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: a positive fee portion (zero here), the charged-off and charged-off-fraud arms (this loan is written off and neither charged off nor fraud), and the buy-down-fee CLASSIFICATION and charge-off-REASON branches (not observed, no input). Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, account and expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
